entries.note: A desktop ID belongs to one authenticated events socket, is refreshed on reconnect, and is never persisted as session ownership. Re-registration updates declared roots/session bindings without changing that connection identity. Validate sessions against declared roots. Require explicit root-associated target, advertised reload support and one pending action; only the same socket can acknowledge its request. Bound waits and reject disconnection. Accepted means the native routine was queued, not that draft flush or rebuild succeeded. The service sends a narrow action and never executes an arbitrary command or replaces a retained process. Optional bounded owner/view strings correlate a supervised native child and its individual spawn. These remain declarations on an authenticated socket, not OS-level confinement or permission to retarget a session.

The attach capability is independent of reload. Check root, target availability and pending actions before script creation; send a root-matching retained session snapshot to the native client and require its matching acknowledgement. Attach never owns the PTY. Reload-specific error text remains stable for existing consumers.
